within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Horocycle/truncation integration selects the constant Fourier mode, the resulting two shifted completed-zeta terms admit a symmetry-blocked product comparison, and T≥1 turns that comparison into a strict half-plane modulus barrier.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: This mechanism proves RH only for the specified integrated/truncated combinations; it neither proves RH for zeta itself nor conceptually explains every Eisenstein coefficient.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: From Fourier projection to a shifted-xi modulus barrier

within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Canonical-polygon semistability selects D_ss in rank two, Weng's lattice Mellin integral becomes an Eisenstein integral over that region, and the fundamental-domain partition converts it to the T=1 truncation integral whose zeros are controlled by Theorem 2.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The rank-two identification does not extend the proved RH result to Weng's higher-rank zeta functions, which have different groups and no asserted Euler product.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Semistability geometry identifies Weng's rank-two zeta with the T=1 theorem

within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Maass-Selberg first confines nonreal zeros to the critical line; positivity and symmetry isolate real zeros in (0,1); the scalar level-set representation then turns the central derivative sign at y* and strict log-derivative monotonicity into creation of one symmetric exceptional pair.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The proof is specific to this completed-zeta combination and depends on delicate formula-level inequalities; the Landau-Siegel language is analogy, not identity of arithmetic mechanism.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Exceptional zeros as a one-parameter level-set bifurcation

within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Writing critical-line values as a sine of a rotating xi phase unifies zero detection, simplicity, an asymptotic counting correction, and monotone motion under T; the failed transfer to a0 pinpoints an oppositely rotating factor and the real-zero escape.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: For a0 the analogous motion and simplicity statements are partly conjectural/numerical and need additional analytic estimates.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The paper itself separates several successful direct verification technologies from the unresolved question of why Eisenstein Fourier coefficients should display RH behavior, then proposes truncation, integrated Bessel functions, full-surface modes, and zero-motion statistics as tests of possible mechanisms.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: These proposals are not established unifications; some are conditional or heuristic and must not be promoted to proved explanations.
